commands:
cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow
echo "=== remaining uncommented fetch-depth across shipped workflows at PR head ==="
for f in devflow-implement.yml devflow.yml ci.yml devflow-runner.yml; do
  echo "--- $f ---"
  git cat-file -p 58a66b7:.github/workflows/$f 2>/dev/null | grep -nE '^[[:space:]]*fetch-depth:' | grep -v '#'
done

for v in 'fetch-depth: 0' 'fetch-depth: 50' "fetch-depth: '50'" 'fetch-depth: "50"' '          #     `fetch-depth: 50`) covers'; do printf '%-40s -> ' "$v"; echo "$v" | grep -qE "fetch-depth:[[:space:]]*['\"]?[1-9]" && echo MATCH || echo no; done

printf '%s\n' 'fetch-depth: 0' 'fetch-depth: 50' "fetch-depth: '50'" 'fetch-depth: "50"' | while IFS= read -r v; do printf '%-24s -> ' "$v"; printf '%s' "$v" | grep -qE "fetch-depth:[[:space:]]*['\"]?[1-9]" && echo MATCH || echo no; done

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
